summary.root_cause_text: Config change moved payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (unreachable); the worker marked orders processed without payment, logged only at DEBUG. Deploy v1.4 (ledger sync batch size tuning) corrupted ledger amounts (about 100x overstated).
recommended: Find out who or what set payments-v2 and why it was unreachable.
Fix the v1.4 sync bug before redeploying.
Alert on DEBUG 'provider call failed' and make the worker fail loudly instead of marking orders processed without payment.

events.text:
version: v1.4
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v2
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5

There are actually two issues here: the payment URL pointing to v2, and the v1.4 sync bug causing cents corruption. The priority order should be to stop ongoing data loss first by reverting the payment URL config to v1, then roll back the sync service to stop corruption, and finally repair the ledger and reprocess affected records.
payment_provider_url: 'internal://payments-v2' -> 'internal://payments-v1'. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
Rolled back version v1.4 -> v1.3. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).
